openQuestions.title: Fix the dead Instrument probe button (id mismatch)
openQuestions.detail: probeAC('instrument', 'hardware') does getElementById('instrument-btn') but the markup declares id="inst-btn" (line 164), so the first probe on the page throws TypeError: Cannot set properties of null (setting 'disabled') and never runs. Rename either side (and re-check 'inst-out' vs 'instrument-out' for the same drift); the player and voip probes use matching ids and work.

summary: Driven headless 2026-08-16: switched all three pattern tabs, then clicked the Instrument 'Probe AudioContext' — console TypeError (null.disabled) from an id mismatch (inst-btn vs instrument-btn) and the output stayed '—'; the other two probes' code paths use matching ids. One real console error on a primary user path.
